codes._note: Same payer + same code, but the criteria SETS differ by diagnosis and by lifecycle stage, so each is its OWN order type — a split, not an internal OR.

criteria.title: Diagnosis of moderately-to-severely active RA
criteria.definition: The patient has a documented diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis.

criteria.title: Inadequate response to a conventional DMARD
criteria.definition: The record documents an inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication to at least one conventional synthetic DMARD (e.g., methotrexate).

criteria.title: TB screening prior to initiation
criteria.definition: The record documents negative or adequately treated latent tuberculosis screening before initiating therapy.

criteria.title: Documented positive clinical response
criteria.definition: The record documents a positive clinical response to infliximab therapy since initiation (e.g., reduction in disease activity).

criteria.title: Continued diagnosis and ongoing need
criteria.definition: The patient continues to carry the rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis and requires ongoing therapy.
